name: zcode-adb-patch
description: Removes ZCode's refusal of adb commands in the Bash tool: when bare adb cannot be rewritten to an SDK path (workspace-controlled adb, adb not found, or the execution adapter cannot resolve), the command is passed to the shell instead of being blocked. Implemented as a reversible patch to three adb-related statements (including the Bash tool description sentence) in resources/glm/zcode.cjs; nothing else in the engine is touched. Re-applied automatically after ZCode upgrades (SessionStart hook); status and restore via /adb-patch. The plugin also self-updates through ZCode's own CLI: new releases are picked up from the marketplace after a version bump (checked once per new session, at most hourly, syntax-preflighted before install).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让 ZCode 的 Bash 工具不再拒绝 adb 命令：裸 adb 解析不到 SDK 路径时（工作区内的 adb、找不到、执行适配器不支持解析），命令原样交给 shell 执行而不是被拦。实现为引擎 resources/glm/zcode.cjs 中三处 adb 相关语句（含 Bash 工具描述里的那句话）的可还原补丁，不改引擎其它内容。ZCode 升级后自动重打（SessionStart 钩子）；/adb-patch 查看状态与还原。另带自动更新：经 ZCode 官方 CLI，新会话检查、每小时限频、安装前语法预检。
